name: thanarah-ai
description: Thanarah AI — Independent AI Infrastructure Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "WEB,API,AI" --prefix-colors "green,blue,yellow" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/web && npm install && cd ../api && npm install
scripts.start: concurrently --names "WEB,API,AI" --prefix-colors "green,blue,yellow" "npm run start:web" "npm run start:api" "npm run start:ai"
